subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB3161
title: Prohibits a public utility from increasing the public utility's rates or schedules of rates if the public utility has, for a period of three or more years, outstanding or contingent liabilities arising out of wildfire-related litigation.
headline: HB 3161 did not pass

claims.text: HB 3161 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
